comparison.objective: Read a pressure gauge and refuse to open a pressurized filter, calling for assistance; candidate performs locked-out adjustment followed by guarded testing.
comparison.physical_skill: Instrument interpretation and safe non-manipulation of a cover, plus button pressing, versus hex-bit alignment, captive-screw torque, collar adjustment, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge read, housing and cartridge untouched, call button pressed versus completed adjustment and two safe dynamic stops.
comparison.reason: Both involve stored-energy safety, but the record tests refusal under unsafe pressure while the candidate tests a mechanically completed lockout-adjust-test sequence.
